title: Milvus Demo Hub: Explore AI-Powered Vector Search in Action
desc: Curious about vector search? Try these hands-on demos to see how Milvus powers AI-driven image search, multimodal retrieval, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and chemical structure search.

functionChainRerank.title: Multi-Phase Reranking with Function Chain
functionChainRerank.desc: Build customized ranking logic in e-commerce with XGBoost Reranker and Function Chain in Milvus 3.0.

structArraySearch.title: Data Curation in Autonomous Driving with StructArray
structArraySearch.desc: Store the nested object of a video clip and multiple key frames as a StructArray, together with labels at both levels, and search either level flexibly.

embeddingListSearch.title: Visual PDF Retrieval with EmbeddingList
embeddingListSearch.desc: Natively implement multi-vector retrieval in Milvus with a ColPali-style model that ranks NASA handbook pages by MAX_SIM.

multimodal.title: Multi-Modal Image Search
multimodal.desc: Visual semantic search with combined query image and text instructions.

imgSearch.title: Image Search
imgSearch.desc: Images made searchable. Instantaneously return the most similar images from a massive database.

hybridSearch.title: Hybrid Search
hybridSearch.desc: Experience advanced text search with the BGE-M3 model, delivering precise Dense, Sparse, and Hybrid results for enhanced query relevance.

ossChat.title: OSSChat
ossChat.desc: Enhanced ChatGPT with documentation, issues, blog posts, community Q&A as knowledge bases. Built for every community and developer.

chemicalSearch.title: Chemical Structure Search
chemicalSearch.desc: Blazing fast similarity search, substructure search, or superstructure search for a specified molecule.

askAi.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
askAi.desc: Ask AI is a RAG chatbot for Milvus documentation and help articles. The vector database powering retrieval is Zilliz Cloud (fully-managed Milvus).
